prompt.zh-TW: 晨光健身房今年本期淨利 {{money:vars.ni}}，年底資產總計 {{money:vars.assets}}。依課程 Excel 口徑（本期淨利 ÷ 期末資產總計）計算資產報酬率（ROA），以百分比作答。
prompt.en: Morning Light Gym had profit for the period of {{money:vars.ni}} and total assets of {{money:vars.assets}} at year end. Using the course Excel basis (profit for the period ÷ closing total assets), what is the return on assets (ROA)? Answer as a percentage.

explanation.zh-TW: Excel 口徑的{{term:tm_r0a5t3kq}}＝{{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}} ÷ {{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}，回答「公司用全部的資產賺回多少」。年報版會把稅後利息加回分子、分母用平均資產，數字會不同，所以題目一定指定版本。
explanation.en: On the Excel basis, {{term:tm_r0a5t3kq}} = {{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}} ÷ {{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}: how much the company earns on all of its assets. The annual-report version adds after-tax interest back to the numerator and uses average assets, which gives a different figure, so every question names its version.
